title: TIFU by replacing all my coffee with decaf
body: I (28M) live with a roommate who drinks my coffee every morning without asking. Last month I quietly swapped the whole bag for decaf and said nothing. After three weeks he asked why he felt tired all the time. I told him. He laughed for a second then got weirdly quiet. Now he buys his own coffee and we barely talk. Not sure if I won or lost.
author: docker_test
